subject: Seed trial pass request for CodeAccelerator cohort
messages:
From: Claire Bowers <claire@codeaccelerator.org>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bulk promo passes for incoming cohort

Hi Jonas,

Hope you’re well — CodeAccelerator is kicking off its next summer cohort (starts Sep 7) and we’d love to offer accepted startups a Redwood starter trial as part of the onboarding bundle. Rough ask: 300–500 single-use trial passes that grant a 30‑day trial with a modest token top-up, to be claimed in the first two weeks of the cohort.

Questions for you:
- Can Redwood generate one-time promo codes that expire after first use?
- Any limits we should be aware of (per-day redemption caps, region restrictions)?
- Do you need any legal/PO or SOW before we distribute?

I attached a short program brief with timeline and expected headcount. Ideally we can have codes ready by Aug 30 so we can include them in the welcome email. Happy to do a 20m sync if easier.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Bowers
Program Director, CodeAccelerator
claire@codeaccelerator.org
[attachment: program_brief.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Claire Bowers <claire@codeaccelerator.org>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bulk promo passes for incoming cohort

Hi Claire — great to hear from you and congrats on the cohort kickoff. We can absolutely do one-time-use promo codes that convert to a 30-day trial. A few quick notes:
- Generation: we can produce unique single-use codes and deliver them as a CSV.
- Redemption constraints: we can scope codes to region=US and set per-code quotas. We also enforce redemption rate limits on our side to protect SLOs, but 300–500 spread across two weeks is reasonable.
- Procurement: for up to 500 small-value trials we usually can proceed on a partner MOU; if you need an invoice/PO we’ll loop finance.

I’m looping Marissa and Monica to propose an ops plan and delivery date. If we can get a recipient CSV (email, name, company, cohort id) by Aug 24 we’ll aim to deliver final codes on Aug 30.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 23 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bulk promo passes for incoming cohort

Thanks Jon — tagging ops. Proposed distribution plan below: 

Plan (recommended)
- Quantity: 400 single-use promo codes (expandable to 500 on approval)
- Product: 30-day starter trial + 50k token credit (non-transferable)
- Campaign name: ACCEL_SEED_AUG26 (for tracking in Console/BI)
- Delivery: codes.csv (one-time-use tokens), plus a public link for partner to download one-time list (S3, expiring link)
- Timeline: partner sends recipient CSV by Aug 24 -> ops generates codes Aug 25–26 -> codes delivered Aug 30 and embedded in welcome email on Sep 1

Cost estimate: unit economics suggest ~ $X per starter (ballpark $X * 400 = ~$Y). Finance sign-off required for amounts > $Z.

Action items for Monica / Karthik:
- Karthik: confirm generation timeline and any rate-limit windows or batching constraints.
- Monica: confirm tracking labels (utm_source, campaign) and whether we should assign a redemption SLA window.

I attached the cohort CSV template we use internally (email, first_name, last_name, company, cohort_id). Please use that format to avoid mapping delays.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Partnerships & Programs, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
[attachment: accelerator_cohort_template.csv (text/csv)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bulk promo passes for incoming cohort

All good from ops — we can generate 400 single-use codes under campaign tag ACCEL_SEED_AUG26. Notes:
- Generation window: Aug 25 08:00–Aug 26 18:00 PT. Codes are nonce-like and will be writable to CSV.
- Delivery: we’ll upload the final CSV to a time-limited S3 link and share with Claire. We can also push codes into a secure partner portal if they prefer.
- Rate limits: to avoid any sudden spikes we recommend staggering distribution emails over a 48h window or instruct partner to stagger sends; otherwise we’ll monitor and throttle at 100 redemptions/minute by default.

Related links: https://hubspot.company/deal/DL-4721 (deal record)

Once Marissa confirms count I’ll schedule generation.

– Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Thanks everyone — attaching the recipient list in the requested template. We went with 420 eligible startups (a few duplicates cleaned out) so please generate 420 single-use codes. Delivery by Aug 30 still works for us; if you can share the expiring S3 link and a human-readable CSV we’ll embed the codes into our welcome messages.

I’m including the cohort owner (partnerships@codeaccelerator.org) on the distribution email. If you need a PO for accounting, let me know and I’ll route it through procurement.

Thanks again — excited to include Redwood in the program.

Claire
